name: Ethiopia Guji Hambela
description: A washed lot from smallholders around Hambela in the Guji zone, roasted light so the florals stay intact. Expect bergamot and white peach up front, a jasmine finish and a tea-like body that gets sweeter as the cup cools. This is the coffee we pour when someone says they do not like coffee.
details: Producers: 400 smallholders through the Buku Sayisa washing station
Process: washed, dried on raised beds
Tasting notes: bergamot, white peach, jasmine
Roasted to order, ships within 48 hours
imageQuery: coffee bag kraft paper pour over ceramic

name: Colombia Huila, La Esperanza
description: From Doña Rosalba Ortiz's five-hectare farm above Pitalito, where we have bought the whole harvest for six years. Red apple and panela sweetness, a cocoa finish and enough body to carry a splash of milk without losing itself. A medium roast that behaves on every brewer in the house.
details: Producer: Rosalba Ortiz, Finca La Esperanza
Tasting notes: red apple, panela, cocoa
Roasted to order, ships within 48 hours
imageQuery: coffee beans roasted bowl wooden table

name: Kenya Nyeri Gatomboya AB
description: Our annual Kenya, from the Gatomboya factory on the slopes of Mount Kenya. Blackcurrant and pink grapefruit with a brown-sugar sweetness and the kind of juicy, tart acidity that only Kenyan coffee delivers. Roasted light and best brewed with slightly hotter water than you think.
details: Producers: Barichu Farmers Cooperative Society, Gatomboya factory
Tasting notes: blackcurrant, pink grapefruit, brown sugar
Limited: roughly 40 bags a week while the lot lasts

name: Guatemala Huehuetenango, Santa Clara
description: Grown at altitude in the dry, high valleys of Huehuetenango and roasted a shade past medium. Milk chocolate and toasted almond with a clean orange brightness that keeps it from getting heavy. The coffee our Seattle baristas reach for when the rain settles in.
details: Producer: Familia Villatoro, Finca Santa Clara
Tasting notes: milk chocolate, toasted almond, orange
Roasted to order, ships within 48 hours
imageQuery: coffee cup latte wooden counter cafe

name: Brazil Cerrado, Boa Vista Natural
description: A natural-process Brazil dried whole in the fruit, which gives it hazelnut, dark chocolate and a dried-fig sweetness with almost no acidity. Big, soft and comforting. It makes an excellent single-origin espresso and an even better pot of drip for a full house.
details: Process: natural, mechanically dried after patio
Tasting notes: hazelnut, dark chocolate, dried fig
Roasted to order, ships within 48 hours

name: Forest Park House Blend
description: The coffee in every carafe at our cafés: Colombia and Brazil, roasted medium, built to taste good at 7 a.m. and still be pleasant at 3 p.m. Caramel, baked apple and a little cocoa, with a round body that takes cream well. Named after the 5,000-acre forest at the edge of Portland.
details: Tasting notes: caramel, baked apple, cocoa
Brews well on anything; our café batch-brew recipe is 60 g per litre
Roasted to order, ships within 48 hours
imageQuery: pouring coffee carafe cups morning kitchen

name: Burnside Espresso
description: Our espresso since the first café. Brazil for body, Guatemala for chocolate and a seasonal Ethiopian for lift, roasted to pull syrupy and sweet at 1:2 in about 28 seconds. Dark chocolate, toffee and a bit of dried cherry in the finish. It stands up to oat milk and disappears into a flat white.
details: Components: Brazil Cerrado, Guatemala Huehuetenango, seasonal Ethiopia
Tasting notes: dark chocolate, toffee, dried cherry
Starting recipe: 18 g in, 36 g out, 26 to 30 seconds, 93°C
Rested 7 to 10 days after roast before we serve it
Roasted to order, ships within 48 hours

name: Cascade Dark Roast
description: A proper dark roast without the ashtray. Sumatra and Brazil taken deep into second crack and pulled before the oils turn bitter, so you get baker's chocolate, molasses and a smoky edge with a thick, low-acid body. The one for the stovetop percolator and the cabin weekend.
details: Tasting notes: baker's chocolate, molasses, pipe tobacco
Very low acidity; a good fit for sensitive stomachs
Roasted to order, ships within 48 hours
imageQuery: dark roasted coffee beans close up scoop

name: Cold Brew Blend
description: Ground coarse and roasted for a 16-hour steep. Brazil and Colombia give it chocolate and a smooth, sweet finish with none of the sourness a hot-brew roast picks up in cold water. One 12-ounce bag makes about two litres of concentrate, enough for a week of iced coffee on the porch.
details: Recipe: 100 g per litre of cold water, 16 hours in the fridge, dilute 1:1
Tasting notes: cocoa, vanilla, graham cracker
Roasted to order, ships within 48 hours
imageQuery: cold brew iced coffee glass ice

name: Colombia Decaf, Sugarcane Process
description: Decaffeinated in Colombia using ethyl acetate derived from fermented sugarcane, which keeps far more of the coffee's own sweetness than solvent methods. Brown sugar, red fruit and a cocoa finish, roasted medium. Most people cannot pick it out of a lineup, which is the point.
details: Process: washed, then sugarcane EA decaffeination at Descafecol
Tasting notes: brown sugar, red fruit, cocoa
Roasted to order, ships within 48 hours
imageQuery: coffee cup saucer evening window warm light

name: Night Shift Decaf Espresso
description: A decaf built the way Burnside is built, not an afterthought. Swiss Water Process Brazil and Colombia, roasted medium-dark for a shot with real body and crema. Milk chocolate, hazelnut and a caramel finish. Order a decaf flat white at any of our cafés and this is what you get.
details: Tasting notes: milk chocolate, hazelnut, caramel
Starting recipe: 18 g in, 38 g out, 28 seconds
Roasted to order, ships within 48 hours

name: Trailhead Instant Coffee Sticks
description: Forest Park House Blend brewed properly, freeze-dried and sealed into single-serve sticks. Tear one into 10 ounces of hot or cold water and you get a genuinely good cup with caramel and cocoa and no silt. Eight sticks to a box, and a box weighs less than a candy bar.
details: Coffee: Forest Park House Blend, freeze-dried
Dissolves in hot or cold water in under 30 seconds
No additives, no sugar, just coffee
